definitions.explanation: The supply or generation of electricity, especially on a large scale. Used in discussions of energy policy, power generation, and infrastructure rather than for small household devices.

examples.japanese: {電力|でんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}→太陽光：06209_taiyoukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{電力|でんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}している→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Systems that generate electricity from solar power are becoming widespread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{電力|でんりょく}{不足|ぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, there are concerns about electricity shortages because air conditioner use increases.

notes:
USAGE:
{電力|でんりょく} refers to electric power on a systemic or industrial scale. For everyday electricity in the home, ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ is more common. {電力|でんりょく} appears frequently in news about energy policy and infrastructure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電力|でんりょく}{会社|がいしゃ} (electric power company)
- {電力|でんりょく}{不足|ぶそく} (electricity shortage)
- {電力|でんりょく}⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧ (electricity supply)
- {電力|でんりょく}⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧ (electricity consumption)
- {電力|でんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧ (to conserve electricity)
- ⟦{再生可能|さいせいかのう}→再生可能：04635_saiseikanou⟧{電力|でんりょく} (renewable electricity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電力|でんりょく}: electric power (large-scale, systemic)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧: electricity (everyday usage; also means lights)
- ⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧: energy (broader term, includes all types)
